subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should zero-overlap Skill Workshop updates override the default `auto` approval policy and always require a pending Gateway approval?
rationale: Merged history intentionally removed the extra approval from normal lifecycle actions, while this data-loss fix proposes a safety exception that changes that user-visible policy contract.

options.title: Confirm the guarded exception
options.body: Treat zero-overlap replacement as a destructive special case, document the exception, and merge after current-head real-workspace proof demonstrates both normal and replacement flows.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto approval
options.body: Keep the existing automatic policy contract and rework the protection around stronger validation, preview, or rejection without adding a conditional Gateway approval.

recommendation.title: Confirm the guarded exception
recommendation.body: Treat zero-overlap replacement as a destructive special case, document the exception, and merge after current-head real-workspace proof demonstrates both normal and replacement flows.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current automatic approval default and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding whether this exception matches its intended contract.
